desc: Prove/verify reduction: f(L,R) = number of runs of consecutive distinct values present in A[L..R].
Derive formula: answer = sum_{v=1}^{N} (#subarrays containing v but not v−1), value 0 treated as absent.
Design contain(v): occurrence gap formula, O(occurrences).
Design both(v): two-pointer next-occurrence sweep with event-jump for O(|P|+|Q|) per pair.
Implement final Python solution with jump-based both() (fast stdin parsing, Python ints) computing sum_v contain(pos[v]) − both(pos[v], pos[v−1]).
Validate against samples (16, 23, 129) and brute-force random small cases; check off-by-one in the jump logic.
